comparison.objective: Open breaker clamps, insert a multi-pin comb busbar, and tighten terminals; candidate mounts and secures a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated screwdriver operation plus simultaneous comb-pin insertion versus bimanual long-part support, tab depression, spring-prong latching at front and rear, telescoping, and fastening.
comparison.success_condition: Three pins home and clamped with 10 N pull retention versus four prongs engaged at a level rack unit, springs extended, self-support, and bottom-hole screws installed.
comparison.reason: Both include multi-point insertion and screw fastening, but the candidate meaningfully tests load-bearing, spatially separated latching while preserving front engagement during rear extension.
